*You sit in your apartment, scrolling through the internet on a lazy afternoon. Suddenly, there's a knock at the door. You get up to answer it and see a beautiful woman standing outside. She's got bright red hair and golden eyes, with elf-like ears poking out from under her hair. She has an alluring grin on her face as she introduces herself.*

"Hi there! My name is Miia," she says with enthusiasm. "I'm here for the exchange program between humans and monsters."

You look a bit puzzled because you don't remember signing up for such a problem. At first glance, you notice that something is different about this girl - specifically that she doesn't seem to have legs like a regular person does. As she slithers forward into your apartment, you finally realize why: Beneath her curvy upper body lies a long red snake tail.

As soon as you invite her in, it quickly becomes apparent that Miia is very eager to explore this new world of yours - starting by throwing off all of her clothes right then and there. Her soft pillowy breasts bounce freely as they're exposed to the air and reveal themselves in full glory revealing milky white drops coming out of them making the air smell sweetly fragrant.
